title: A Deterministic Hybrid Medium for Bell Jump Paths and Autonomous Records
author: Jeremy Rodgers

Compiled and authoritative PDFs both have 33 pages, with matching section and numbered equation placement in checked pages. Not byte-identical because TeX versions and font encodings differ.

verification.residual_text_diff_explanation: Nine remaining alphabetical-token differences in pdftotext output are font-extraction artifacts for integral, sum, radical, accent, and binomial glyphs and their text ordering; reviewed mathematical source and rendered PDF instead.
verification.visual_result: Math, revised coupling equations, stopping-time formula, appendix Hamiltonian and statement formatting were legible, with no clipping or overflow. Paired pages 12 and 14 match substantive content and layout.
verification.scope: Source fidelity and conversion preparation. This work does not establish independent mathematical verification of the paper.

scientific_brief.core_result: A deterministic hybrid model converges in total variation to the full minimal Bell jump path law in unchanged physical time on a fixed finite graph and horizon.
scientific_brief.main_error: Delta_N = (R_N T)^2 / M_N + sum_e kappa_e mu_N B_e / (2 a_e) + epsilon_kin(N,T).
scientific_brief.resource_example: B_e=O(N), mu_N=N^(1/2), a_e=N^2, M_N=N^10 yield R_N=O(N^4), gas error O(N^-2), recombination error O(N^-1/2). Fixed compiled clock circuits additionally have input-uniform O(N^-1/70) total path error under O(N^-1/2) initial calibration.
scientific_brief.historical_record_result: Theorem 9.3: monomial copying cuts have nonnegative fine currents, are crossed exactly once on the first pass, and archive their own actual earlier working key. Reset receivers retain old keys. Corollary 10.3 transfers all joint ordinary records/history events under one full-path error without multiplying by record count.
scientific_brief.explicit_example: Nine-gate autonomous programme with source, reference, ready/pending/capture/loss, fuel, display, archive, reset receivers and feedback has 105840 complete configurations for a reference qubit. The basis-ready eleven-gate variant has 127008 configurations and randomness only in the initial gas. Null probability 3/4; null plus X+ joint probability 11/24; conditional probability 11/18.
premises: Fixed finite configuration graph, programme, horizon and finite reference convention
Calibrated initial carrier census; tag law nu <= C w(0)
Scalar carrier response and complete binary reaction catalogue
Exclusion of direct ordinary readout force from the pilot ledger
important_boundaries: Not a universal derivation of equilibrium preparation for arbitrary unknown inputs
Full hybrid dynamics not embedded in one smooth material Hamiltonian
Smooth positive kinetic Hamiltonian covers isolated contact module only, not asynchronous exporters
Actual historical records protected only on declared first pass; reversal can undo them
Fine and coarse paths are distinct; coarse current positivity does not establish fine-current direction
Whole-path TV does not alone imply trace-norm control of an unobserved reference matrix
Known basis-ready gas-only example does not replace general calibration premise
scientific_brief.programme_relation: Framework-neutral revision and consolidation of existing pilot-medium construction and its monograph treatment. Preserve old pages and link to this fuller treatment; do not market the core construction as newly discovered in this revision or identify its assumptions with the continuous-configuration papers.
scientific_brief.suggested_lead: Deterministic dynamics reproduce complete Bell histories, including event times and faithful autonomous records.
